page.overview:
What is Madril?

Madril was an older Ranger of Ithilien and Faramir's second in command at Henneth Annûn and later at Osgiliath. Madril was portrayed by John Bach.

Alongside Lieutenant Cirion, Madril was on the scene for Gondor's first encounters with Khandish and Easterling forces that entered from Rhûn and beyond before the War of the Ring during the closing years of the Third Age.

Madril was a Ranger of some experience. He was both an adviser and second-in-command to Faramir, helping him in his ambush of the Haradrim in North Ithilien, preventing them from moving forward to Mordor. He was with Faramir when where they also captured Frodo Baggins and Samwise Gamgee in their camp. During a short stay at Henneth Annûn, Madril gave a number of reports to Faramir on the events of the war elsewhere in Middle-earth, including Rohan. He later received a report from a scout that Osgiliath was under attack and the garrison there requested reinforcements. Eventually, the company moved on to Osgiliath to reinforce its garrison. Despite initial doubts, the Orcs held off the attack. When victory was within reach, Madril reminded Faramir that letting the hobbits go would cause him to be forfeit by his father.

Arriving to Osgiliath during a skirmish, Madril went ahead with the rest of the troops into the city and gained an overview of the situation. Thus, he told Faramir that Orcs had taken the eastern shore. When Faramir gave him the Hobbits, so that they could be brought to his father in Minas Tirith, one of the Nazgûl arrived, forcing Madril and the Rangers to take cover. After the Nazgûl fled and Faramir decided to let the Hobbits go, Madril reminded him that he risked losing his life if he failed to deliver the One Ring to Gondor.
